# Sri Vinayaka Group

> South India's premier multi-vertical transportation and logistics enterprise. Driven by Trust, Sri Vinayaka Group operates luxury overnight AC sleeper bus routes connecting Bangalore and Coorg (Madikeri, Virajpet, Gonikoppa), guaranteed next-morning express cargo parcel logistics, and customized South India holiday tours.

## Corporate Overview
- **Enterprise Name**: Sri Vinayaka Group
- **Tagline**: Driven by Trust
- **Headquarters**: Sri Vinayaka Tours and Travels, Opp to KSRTC Bus Stand, Virajpet, Karnataka - 571218
- **Primary Website**: https://srivinayakagroup.com/

## Core Services & Verticals

### 1. Bangalore ↔ Coorg Luxury AC Sleeper Bus
- **Route**: Daily bidirectional overnight luxury sleeper connectivity between Bangalore and Kodagu (Coorg).
- **Fleet**: BharatBenz and multi-axle 2+1 business-class sleeper coaches.
- **Fixed Departures**: 
  - Evening Coaches: 21:30 (9:30 PM) & 21:50 (9:50 PM) daily.
- **Key Boarding & Dropping Points (24 Locations)**:
  - **Bangalore**: Madiwala, Kalasipalyam, Majestic / Anand Rao Circle, Navrang, Rajajinagar, Yeshwantpur, Goraguntepalya, Jalahalli Cross, 8th Mile, Nelamangala Toll, Kengeri, Satellite Bus Stand.
  - **Coorg / Kodagu**: Kushalnagar, Suntikoppa, Madikeri, Murnad, Napoklu, Virajpet, Gonikoppa, Ponnampet, Kutta, Kanoor, Balele.
- **Amenities**: Individual privacy curtains, wide ergonomic orthopedic mattresses, high-speed mobile USB & Type-C chargers, individual AC vents & reading lights, digital entertainment, sanitised luxury blankets & pillows, 24x7 GPS tracking, professional 2-driver system.
- **URL**: https://srivinayakagroup.com/sleeper-services.html

### 2. Express Overnight Cargo & Parcel Delivery
- **Service Standard**: Guaranteed overnight parcel transport across Bangalore, Mysore, Madikeri, Virajpet, Gonikoppa, and surrounding taluks.
- **SLA**: Book before 6:00 PM in Bangalore/Coorg for guaranteed 7:00 AM counter pickup next morning.
- **Cargo Handled**: Commercial cartons, estate produce (coffee, pepper, cardamom, spices), machinery spare parts, documents & parcels, e-commerce shipments, household luggage.
- **Features**: Doorstep pickup/delivery on select corridors, digital receipting & SMS dispatch tracking, fragile cargo secure handling, dedicated warehouse hubs.
- **Bangalore Cargo Hub**: Kalasipalyam & Gandhinagar (+91 9448325657)
- **Coorg Cargo Hubs**: Virajpet, Madikeri, Gonikoppa, Kushalnagar
- **URL**: https://srivinayakagroup.com/logistics.html

### 3. Weekend Getaways, School Trips & Luxury Coach Charters
- **Specialized Circuits & Categories**:
  - *Weekend Getaway Trips*: Coorg coffee plantation trails, Mysore royal heritage, Wayanad, Ooty, and Chikmagalur with onboard DJ sound systems, laser lighting, custom homestays, and campfires.
  - *School & College Educational Trips*: Safe student field trips, academy excursions, campus pick-and-drop, verified senior drivers, GPS speed tracking, and discounted institutional rates.
  - *Fleet Hire & Custom Charters*: Luxury AC pushback coaches (KA51AC4365, KA51AC6282) for corporate offsites, college industrial visits, destination weddings, and pilgrimage tours.
- **URL**: https://srivinayakagroup.com/tours.html
